editorialDecl.p: This transcription was produced in plain text according to the IGNTP guidelines, and converted to XML using Python scripts at the Institute for Textual Scholarship and Electronic Editing and the University of Birmingham.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at
